author: elonmusk
text:
An extraordinary map shows the extent that births have fallen around the world.

France, Germany, Italy and the UK peaked in births more than 100 years ago.

East Asia, Russia and much of Eastern Europe are now 75% below their peaks in births!

Thanks @ErminiaDark
